events.text: Fixed native wheel ownership at the framework boundary: before model-camera zoom, engine.zig now asks events.zig whether a ScrollView owns the pointer position. Ownership covers the full visible container, including blank space, rather than depending on an interactive child hit. Added a Zig regression for blank body, child button, and outside points. Passed test-events and the complete ReleaseFast editor ship build.

resolution: Wheel routing now resolves the ScrollView under the pointer before native Studio camera zoom. The scroll surface owns its entire visible rectangle—including blank padding and gaps—so entering or leaving a child button no longer changes the wheel target; the camera receives the wheel only when no scroll container or explicit chrome control claims that point.
